description: This file implements a minimal wrapper around Supabase REST and authentication endpoints using httpx. It provides methods for user sign-up, sign-in, password update, and database operations such as select, insert, update, and delete, encapsulated within the SupabaseClient class. It also includes a utility function to instantiate the client with environment-configured settings.

classes.description: A wrapper for Supabase REST and Auth endpoints, facilitating server-side operations with methods for user authentication and database manipulations.
